display_name: 兔子镜小剧场 / Rabbit Mirror Theater（Beta v1.1・挨打猫 v1.4・维修兔 v1.68.1・性能热修）
author: Toto
description: RabbitMirror Beta v1.1. Supports family-balanced random themes and presentation forms, source-message-scoped user-priority custom requests that work even when the mother library has no matching item, and fresh local random picks for every non-directed assistant generation or regeneration. Includes interactive RabbitMirror scenes, optional memory-based flashbacks, Feedback Cat, Maintenance Rabbit v1.68.1 with detached :has() radio/content-state recovery, persistent unlabeled focus-within flip recovery, second-state-only touch Hover recovery, generation-integrity validation, temporary complete-source snapshots, and a readable per-generation token meter. Maintenance, diagnostics, and generation de-duplication run locally and do not add model tokens. Includes a SillyTavern UI performance hotfix with scoped DOM observation and complete listener cleanup. Source available, not open source; see LICENSE.
